description: This file contains unit tests for functions 'filterSupportedLanguageHints' and 'normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages', which are used for processing language hints in diff payloads within a code review or diff viewer context.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters an array of language hints to include only supported ones, resolving invalid hints to 'text'.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes language hints in a diff payload, downgrading invalid or stale hints to 'text', and handling multiple languages for diff views.
